title: Weight Space Programming for Vision Language Model Repair
abstract: arXiv:2611.23615v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In weight-space programming, a language model edits a network's weights directly, without gradients. We ask what a successful repair of this kind relies on. We plant faults in the weights of two vision-language models, SmolVLM-256M and LFM2-VL-450M, and check each edit made by a coding agent against the original weights. Without being told where to look, the agent finds rescaled rows in the projector and noise in the vision encoder of both models, infers the unknown scale factors, restores most or all of the rescaled weights to their exact original values, and returns accuracy to near its original level; programs that it writes from such weights repair unseen checkpoints of the same model without feedback. These repairs depend on a trace of how the faults were computed. translated_title: 用于视觉语言模型修复的权重空间编程
translated_abstract: 在权重空间编程中，语言模型无需梯度即可直接编辑网络的权重。我们探究这类成功修复依赖于什么。我们在两个视觉语言模型SmolVLM-256M和LFM2-VL-450M的权重中植入故障，并将编程智能体所做的每次编辑与原始权重进行核对。在没有被告知查找位置的情况下，该智能体在两个模型的投影器中发现了被重新缩放的行、在视觉编码器中发现了噪声，推断出未知的缩放因子，将被重新缩放的大多数或全部权重恢复到其精确的原始值，并将准确率恢复到接近原始水平；它根据这些权重编写的程序无需反馈即可修复同一模型未见过的检查点。这些修复依赖于故障是如何被计算的痕迹。原始权重具有16位精度，而在32位算术中计算的故障会留下只有受损权重才携带的低位比特。将这些低位比特舍去会……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 语言模型无需梯度即可直接修复被植入故障的视觉语言模型权重：它能自主定位投影器中的缩放故障和视觉编码器中的噪声、推断缩放因子并将权重精确恢复至原始值，还能据此写出可修复同模型未见检查点的通用修复程序，其修复能力依赖于16位精度权重中残留的低位比特痕迹。
en_tdlr: A language model repairs fault-planted vision-language model weights directly without gradients—autonomously locating rescaled projector rows and vision-encoder noise, inferring scale factors to restore weights exactly, and writing general repair programs that fix unseen checkpoints without feedback, relying on low-bit traces left by faults computed in higher precision.
